rules: same full_identity and overlapping intervals with different security_type => FAIL_CLOSED
same ticker with different full_identity across intervals => TICKER_REUSE_REVIEW
same ticker/full_identity with duplicate payload => deduplicate only after exact raw hash comparison
market/security_type conflict at same effective date => unresolved, no silent overwrite
missing date or unlabelled response => reject row
current 2026-08-21 snapshot cannot fill historical gaps
